items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Buster Harding was the arranger, but we had two pianists. He played with Teddy.

ctx.x: It was a most decidated band. Dedicated bunch of guys that I had ever been with during our short span. when we played at the Golden Guts Ballroom Nobody was ever late. If we had rehearsal, the reeds would rehearse in one section, maybe the ladies room, and the brass would rehearse in the men's room and we'd come on the
bandstand and everybody had to get an 'A' (inaudible) and our rhythm section was a gas. Buster Harding, Buster Harding was the arranger, but we had two pianists. He played with Teddy.
Right. And Ben Webster was in that band?
